milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near a red mushroom and face it to demonstrate they have located it. The closest red mushroom is at spawn-relative (-7, 0, 0), with another at (-6, 0, 3). Using max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 to model 'player can see the red mushroom'. Target is set to the nearest mushroom at (-7, 0, 0) which was confirmed visible from near spawn in sandbox testing.
